Messages.Author: Alec Chang
Messages.Body:
An open question, and specifically, L. Scott, since our "official"
netrep does not seem to exist anymore...

Selma has a ghoul retainer, a murder of crows, and is attacking
Anson via a haven uncovered. Anson cannot avoid combat. Selma
plays a disguised weapon/ Submachine gun. Can she hand the
submachine gun to her ghoul, use the manuver, and toss sewer lid?
Or does using the manuver require that Selma use the SMG? Can
retainers manuver for vampires in this fashion?

Thanks in advance for the ruling(opinion?) L. Scott...

Alec Chang

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Alec Chang <te...@lava.net> writes:
>An open question, and specifically, L. Scott, since our "official"
>netrep does not seem to exist anymore...

Happy to be of service.

>Selma has a ghoul retainer, a murder of crows, and is attacking
>Anson via a haven uncovered. Anson cannot avoid combat. Selma
>plays a disguised weapon/ Submachine gun. Can she hand the
>submachine gun to her ghoul, use the manuver, and toss sewer lid?
>Or does using the manuver require that Selma use the SMG? Can
>retainers manuver for vampires in this fashion?
>Thanks in advance for the ruling(opinion?) L. Scott...

1) If Selma maneuvers with a strike-provider, then that locks *her*
strike for the initial strike of the round. So, she can't then throw
the sewer lid, regardless of what the Ghoul wishes to use. (Another
way of looking at this is that the Ghoul's use of the weapon doesn't
constitute a "strike", so won't fulfill the requirements of using the
weapon's maneuver).

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: Acrobatics vs Canine Horde

Andrea Williams <a...@sun.lclark.edu> wrote:
>But this does raise an interesting question: Can the gun's strike be used
>on the additional strike gained? One is still using the gun for
>one's strike, just not the one immediately after the maneuver.

Using a gun's maneuver locks you into striking with that gun for the
initial strike of the round. If your minion gets additional strikes,
any strike can be used for the additionals, including firing the gun again.

----
From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: Retainers vs. dodges
Date: 2 Jan 1996 18:44:58 GMT
Message-ID: <4cbufa$h...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

Dodges just prevent effects of strikes, and damage from retainers (even
damage provided by a weapon via Ghoul Retainer) are just collateral damage.
While the damage may be prevented, it cannot be avoided with a dodge.

----------

2) Retainers cannot use maneuvers in the stead of their employer.
Some retainers provide maneuvers to their employer (Ms. Therman),
but it is still the employer who must use the maneuver.

J. Hunter Johnson <jhun...@pentagon.io.com> wrote:
>In general, retainers can't use equipment or deal damage in combat.
>Ghoul Retainer may be able to get away with using another weapon's
>maneuver.

Ghould Retainer can strike with a weapon, but wouldn't be able to use it
to maneuver.
